resources.string: Choose a profile and optimize when you are ready.
Custom plan. Review the selected actions and options below.
Advanced usage-based dexopt and Android storage maintenance. Duration depends on your apps and device.
Full app compilation, storage maintenance, and zRAM compaction. Uses more time, power, and disk space. Requires charging or battery above 25%.
Maintenance utilities for cache, app activity, and system resources.
Actions completed in the latest optimization run.
Let independent actions run if an earlier action fails.
Cancellation stops upcoming work. A cache or storage request already accepted by Android may finish in the background.
Owner user only. Personal files and app data are preserved. Free memory and compilation coverage are not device health scores.

Full compilation requires charging or battery above 25% and may take a long time. It can use additional storage; compilation stops before the next app if unplugged battery reaches 25% or the device becomes too warm.
Only the selected actions will run. You can leave this screen and return to see progress.
Scan cache usage and clean only the apps you select.
Ask Android to schedule filesystem maintenance, including supported GC/TRIM work.
Request compressed-memory compaction when supported by the kernel. Does not close your apps.
Compile installed apps with ART. Profile-guided compilation is the default; apps already optimized may be skipped.

Uses 14 days of owner usage: at least 1 hour of foreground use and opened within 7 days → speed; other recent use → speed-profile; older usage → verify. Unknown usage → speed-profile. Android 16 uses verify instead of quicken. Speed requires charging or battery above 25%.
No apps compiled in this run yet.
No dexopt results in this run yet.
Requested filter and ART result for this run. Skipped means ART kept existing code; the requested filter may not have been applied. Verify does not force a downgrade of existing compiled code.
Showing the first 300 apps. All eligible apps are still processed.
Choose at least one app before running App Cache Cleaner.
Cache sizes are measured for installed owner-user apps. Select only the app caches you want included in Main Maintenance.
Apps and data excluding cache: %1$s. Cache: %2$s.
Scan apps to measure cache usage.
Clean the system resource and package cache directories.
Cleans the contents of /data/resources_cache and /data/system/package_cache. The directories themselves are preserved.
Data cache cleanup completed. Restart the device to let Android rebuild and reload the cleaned system caches.
Find rarely used third-party apps that are still active in the background.
The scan lists stoppable apps with no foreground use in the last 24 hours that currently have a background process.
Rank running system processes and apps by memory and sampled CPU use.
CPU is sampled over a short interval. RAM is proportional set size; background state comes from Android process importance.
